shared_backbone_note: Shared parameters moving during a single-latent update is CORRECT and is not asserted against. The invariant is that the OTHER latent's private branch stays bit-identical.

no_LRO_fixture.why: without LRO there are no private branches, so an isolation claim would be vacuously true

alpha_zero_fixture.why: zero-init adapters under gating form the zero-gradient degenerate equilibrium that was the V6I22E root cause
